annotations.title: Distance between coordinates: km, miles, bearing and midpoint

description: Great-circle distance between two latitude/longitude points (haversine on the mean earth radius) in kilometres, miles and nautical miles, plus the initial compass bearing and the midpoint. Accurate to about 0.5% against the ellipsoid. Use for delivery radius, travel and proximity checks, or sorting places by distance; for coordinates of a place name use geocode first. Example: lat1=59.3293, lon1=18.0686, lat2=51.5072, lon2=-0.1276. Price $0.002/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

lat1.description: Latitude of the first point (-90 to 90)

lon1.description: Longitude of the first point (-180 to 180)
